diagnostics.message: "pages.capabilities.history" grants capabilities to a route served in "chromium" mode. Only bundled pages can hold capabilities.
"pages.capabilities.downloads" grants capabilities to a route served in "native" mode. Only bundled pages can hold capabilities.
"pages.capabilities.ghost" grants capabilities to a route that does not exist.
"pages.capabilities.prefs" grants capabilities to an alias. An alias carries its target's capabilities.
